title: VR Headset
prompt: VR Headset: Futuristic visor with blue digital glow.
code:
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#0a0a0e"/>
  
  <!-- Glow Filter for HUD and Visor light -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8" result="blur"/>
      <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over"/>
    </filter>
    
    <linearGradient id="visorGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#001a33" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#004d99" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#001a33" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="edgeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#444" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#222" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#333" />
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="centerGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00ffff" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00ffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Headset Straps (Sides) -->
  <path d="M220 300 Q 150 300 120 450 L 160 460 Q 180 340 240 340 Z" fill="#1a1a1a" />
  <path d="M580 300 Q 650 300 680 450 L 640 460 Q 620 340 560 340 Z" fill="#1a1a1a" />

  <!-- Main Headset Body -->
  <rect x="220" y="260" width="360" height="180" rx="50" fill="url(#edgeGrad)" />
  
  <!-- Visor Frame (Bezel) -->
  <rect x="245" y="285" width="310" height="130" rx="35" fill="#111" />

  <!-- The Visor Display Area -->
  <rect x="255" y="295" width="290" height="110" rx="30" fill="url(#visorGrad)" />

  <!-- Digital Content (HUD Elements) Inside Visor -->
  <!-- Large soft center light -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="350" r="60" fill="url(#centerGlow)" filter="url(#glow)" />
  
  <!-- Grid pattern -->
  <g stroke="#00ffff" stroke-opacity="0.15">
    <line x1="270" y1="320" x2="530" y2="320" />
    <line x1="270" y1="350" x2="530" y2="350" />
    <line x1="270" y1="380" x2="530" y2="380" />
    <line x1="300" y1="295" x2="300" y2="405" />
    <line x1="360" y1="295" x2="360" y2="405" />
    <line x1="420" y1="295" x2="420" y2="405" />
    <line x1="480" y1="295" x2="480" y2="405" />
  </g>

  <!-- Data Lines/Shapes -->
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <!-- Floating scanning line -->
    <rect x="260" y="348" width="280" height="2" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.6">
       <animate attributeName="y" values="300;400;300" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </rect>

    <!-- Small data blocks -->
    <rect x="280" y="315" width="15" height="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.8" />
    <rect x="280" y="325" width="10" height="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.5" />
    
    <rect x="490" y="375" width="20" height="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.8" />
    <circle cx="505" cy="365" r="3" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.6" />

    <!-- Geometric HUD circle -->
    <circle cx="470" cy="340" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,3" opacity="0.7" />
  </g>

  <!-- Highlights on the Plastic Body -->
  <path d="M240 280 Q 400 260 560 280" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.1" />
  <path d="M240 430 Q 400 450 560 430" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.05" />

  <!-- Final blue glow bloom around the whole headset -->
  <rect x="220" y="260" width="360" height="180" rx="50" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.05" filter="url(#glow)" />
</svg>
